entities.summary: Shridhar Chillal is an Indian man from the city of Pune, who held the world record for the longest fingernails ever reached on a single hand, with a combined length of 909.6 centimeters. Chillal's longest single nail was his thumbnail, which measured 197.8 centimeters. He stopped cutting his nails in 1952.
